title: Convert Currency Along Directed Rates
prompt:
Implement `solution(pairs, ratios, src, dst)`. Each pair `(a, b)` is a directed conversion: one unit of `a` becomes the corresponding positive number of units of `b`. Find a path from `src` to `dst` and return the product of its ratios. Return `-1.0` if no path exists, and `1.0` when `src == dst`. The input rates are consistent: whenever multiple paths connect the same currencies, they have the same product. A pair does not imply its reverse conversion.

`pairs` and `ratios` have equal lengths. Explain the search and its time and space costs.
